lines.cap: Death needed a flu shot. The most powerful being in the universe. Terrified.
lines.say: Death needed a flu shot. The most powerful being in the universe. Terrified.

lines.cap: Just a small injection, sir. You'll feel a tiny pinch.
lines.say: Just a small injection, sir. You'll feel a tiny pinch.

lines.cap: I have collected ten billion souls. I cannot look at the needle.
lines.say: I have collected ten billion souls. I cannot look at the needle.

lines.cap: Can I come back tomorrow? Or next century?
lines.say: Can I come back tomorrow? Or next century?
lines.bubble: CAN I COME BACK NEXT CENTURY? 🙏

lines.cap: Then a small hand takes his. It's the brave kid from room four.
lines.say: Then a small hand takes his. It's the brave kid from room four.

lines.cap: It's okay, uncle. Look at me. Squeeze my hand. It's over fast.
lines.say: It's okay, uncle. Look at me. Squeeze my hand. It's over fast.
lines.bubble: LOOK AT ME. SQUEEZE MY HAND. 🤝

lines.cap: The injection is done. Death didn't even feel it.
lines.say: The injection is done. Death didn't even feel it.

lines.cap: That's. That's it? You were very brave for me.
lines.say: That's. That's it? You were very brave for me.
lines.bubble: THAT'S IT? YOU WERE BRAVE FOR ME. 🥹

lines.cap: Tag who holds your hand at the doctor. Even Death needed it.
lines.say: Tag who holds your hand at the doctor. Even Death needed it.
